widget.missFeedback: Start at 15 and make 8 hops left, one number at a time.

predict.prompt: 15 − 8 comes back fastest through which partner fact?
predict.reveal: The addition partner names the answer directly: 8 + 7 = 15, so 15 − 8 = 7.
